lessons.title: 汉语可以这样学
lessons.titleEn: You Can Learn Chinese This Way

examples.zh: 冬至那天，我们在宿舍一起包水饺。
examples.en: On the winter solstice, we made dumplings together in the dorm.

examples.zh: 这家店的水饺皮薄馅儿多，特别好吃。
examples.en: The dumplings here have thin wrappers and lots of filling—really delicious.

examples.zh: 学外语的时候，犯错误是很正常的。
examples.en: Making mistakes is perfectly normal when you're learning a foreign language.

examples.zh: 这个规定很清楚，你可别犯规。
examples.en: This rule is very clear, so don't break it.

examples.zh: 汉语有四个声调，很多外国人觉得很难。
examples.en: Chinese has four tones, and many foreigners find them hard.

examples.zh: 你说这个词的时候，要注意声调。
examples.en: Pay attention to the tones when you say this word.

examples.zh: 在中国，朋友见面一般不吻脸。
examples.en: In China, friends don't usually kiss on the cheek when they meet.

examples.zh: 妈妈在机场吻了吻我的额头。
examples.en: My mom kissed me on the forehead at the airport.

examples.zh: 我把老师读课文的声音录了下来。
examples.en: I recorded the teacher reading the text aloud.

examples.zh: 你可以录一段视频，看看自己的发音。
examples.en: You can record a video and check your own pronunciation.

examples.zh: 这段录音我反复听了好几遍。
examples.en: I listened to this recording over and over again.

examples.zh: 生词要反复练习才能记住。
examples.en: You have to practice new words repeatedly to remember them.

examples.zh: 他每天模仿中国人的发音和语调。
examples.en: He imitates Chinese people's pronunciation and intonation every day.

examples.zh: 小孩子学说话主要靠模仿。
examples.en: Little children learn to talk mainly by imitating.

examples.zh: 这两个汉字长得很相似，很容易写错。
examples.en: These two characters look very similar and are easy to mix up.

examples.zh: 我和同屋有很多相似的爱好。
examples.en: My roommate and I have a lot of similar hobbies.

examples.zh: 在中国学汉语，要好好利用语言环境。
examples.en: When learning Chinese in China, you should make good use of the language environment.

examples.zh: 我利用坐地铁的时间背生词。
examples.en: I use my time on the subway to memorize new words.

examples.zh: 课堂上老师让我们多说汉语。
examples.en: In class, the teacher has us speak as much Chinese as possible.

examples.zh: 光靠课堂学习是不够的。
examples.en: Studying in class alone isn't enough.

words.meaning: sautéed sweet corn with pine nuts

examples.zh: 松仁玉米又香又甜，留学生都爱点。
examples.en: Sautéed corn with pine nuts is fragrant and sweet—international students love ordering it.

examples.zh: A：你想吃什么？B：来一份松仁玉米吧。
examples.en: A: What would you like? B: Let's get a plate of sautéed corn with pine nuts.

words.meaning: component of a Chinese character; radical

examples.zh: 知道偏旁的意思，就容易猜出汉字的意思。
examples.en: If you know what a component means, it's easier to guess what a character means.

examples.zh: “妈”和“姐”有相同的偏旁。
examples.en: 妈 and 姐 share the same component.

examples.zh: 查字典的时候，可以按部首查。
examples.en: When using a dictionary, you can look a character up by its radical.

examples.zh: “河”的部首是三点水。
examples.en: The radical of 河 is the "three drops of water" radical.

examples.zh: 用故事记忆汉字，效果特别好。
examples.en: Memorizing characters through stories works especially well.

examples.zh: 年纪大了以后，奶奶的记忆越来越差了。
examples.en: As she has gotten older, Grandma's memory has gotten worse and worse.

examples.zh: 公园里有很多高大的松树。
examples.en: There are many tall pine trees in the park.

examples.zh: 这棵松已经有几百年了。
examples.en: This pine tree is several hundred years old.

examples.zh: 松鼠桂鱼是一道有名的苏州菜。
examples.en: Squirrel-shaped mandarin fish is a famous Suzhou dish.

examples.zh: 第一次听到“松鼠桂鱼”这个菜名，我以为是用松鼠做的。
examples.en: The first time I heard the name of the dish 松鼠桂鱼, I thought it was made from squirrel.

examples.zh: 老师让我们给这篇短文挑错。
examples.en: The teacher asked us to find the mistakes in this short passage.

examples.zh: 他总爱挑错，别人做什么他都不满意。
examples.en: He's always finding fault—nothing anyone does satisfies him.

examples.zh: 老师耐心地纠正我的发音。
examples.en: The teacher patiently corrects my pronunciation.

examples.zh: 如果我说错了，请你马上纠正我。
examples.en: If I say something wrong, please correct me right away.

examples.zh: 有不懂的地方，我常常向中国同学请教。
examples.en: When there's something I don't understand, I often ask my Chinese classmates for help.

examples.zh: 老师，我想请教您一个问题。
examples.en: Teacher, may I ask you a question?

examples.zh: 这个软件能识别手写的汉字。
examples.en: This app can recognize handwritten Chinese characters.

examples.zh: 我还不太会识别不同的方言。
examples.en: I can't really tell different dialects apart yet.

examples.zh: 我手机上装了一个学汉语的软件。
examples.en: I installed a Chinese-learning app on my phone.

examples.zh: 这个软件可以帮我纠正声调。
examples.en: This software can help me correct my tones.

examples.zh: 只要不断练习，口语一定会提高。
examples.en: As long as you keep practicing, your spoken Chinese is bound to improve.

examples.zh: 来中国以后，我的汉语水平不断提高。
examples.en: Since coming to China, my Chinese has kept improving.

examples.zh: 多看中文电影能练听力，此外还能了解中国文化。
examples.en: Watching Chinese films trains your listening; besides, you learn about Chinese culture.

examples.zh: 这本书有图片，此外还配有录音。
examples.en: This book has pictures and, in addition, audio recordings.

examples.zh: 她善于利用各种机会练习口语。
examples.en: She's good at using every opportunity to practice speaking.

examples.zh: 善于发现问题的人，进步也快。
examples.en: People who are good at spotting problems also improve quickly.

examples.zh: 你爱唱歌，我爱跳舞，他爱打乒乓球，总之，都有自己的爱好。
examples.en: You enjoy singing, I enjoy dancing, and he enjoys table tennis. In short, we all have our own hobbies.

examples.zh: 总之，我觉得这个办法值得一试。
examples.en: In short, I think this method is worth trying.

examples.zh: 他给每个汉字都编了一个小故事。
examples.en: He made up a little story for every character.

examples.zh: 别编理由了，你就是忘了做作业。
examples.en: Stop making up excuses—you just forgot to do your homework.

examples.zh: 看中国电影的时候，我喜欢开着中文字幕。
examples.en: When I watch Chinese films, I like to have the Chinese subtitles on.

examples.zh: 这部电视剧没有英文字幕，我只能看懂一半。
examples.en: This TV series has no English subtitles, so I only understand half of it.

examples.zh: 读中文小说可以积累词汇。
examples.en: Reading Chinese novels helps you build up your vocabulary.

examples.zh: 我的词汇量还不够，很多话说不出来。
examples.en: My vocabulary isn't big enough yet, so there's a lot I can't say.

words.meaning: achieve many purposes at one stroke

examples.zh: 参加汉语角既能练口语，又能交朋友，一举多得。
examples.en: Joining the Chinese corner lets you practice speaking and make friends—lots of benefits at once.

examples.zh: A：周末我要去中国朋友家做客。B：好主意，练口语、了解文化，一举多得！
examples.en: A: I'm visiting a Chinese friend's home this weekend. B: Great idea—speaking practice and culture, all in one go!

examples.zh: 在中国，红色有吉祥、喜庆的寓意。
examples.en: In China, red carries the meaning of good luck and celebration.

examples.zh: 这个故事的寓意是做事不能着急。
examples.en: The moral of this story is that you shouldn't rush things.

examples.zh: 她穿着一件红色的旗袍去参加婚礼。
examples.en: She wore a red qipao to the wedding.

examples.zh: 我想买一件旗袍带回国送给妈妈。
examples.en: I want to buy a qipao to take home for my mom.

examples.zh: 每个国家都有自己的结婚习俗。
examples.en: Every country has its own wedding customs.

examples.zh: 春节贴对联是中国的传统习俗。
examples.en: Putting up couplets at Spring Festival is a traditional Chinese custom.

examples.zh: 很多少数民族的服装颜色都很鲜艳。
examples.en: The clothing of many ethnic minorities is very brightly colored.

examples.zh: 这家商店的夏季服装正在打折。
examples.en: This store's summer clothing is on sale.

examples.zh: 到了一个新地方，要尊重当地的风俗。
examples.en: When you go somewhere new, you should respect the local customs.

examples.zh: 中国南方和北方的风俗不太一样。
examples.en: Customs in southern and northern China are rather different.

examples.zh: 很多年轻人崇拜自己喜欢的明星。
examples.en: Many young people idolize their favorite celebrities.

examples.zh: 古时候，人们对太阳有一种崇拜。
examples.en: In ancient times, people worshipped the sun.

examples.zh: 红色给人一种温暖的感觉。
examples.en: Red gives people a feeling of warmth.

examples.zh: 生病的时候，同学们的关心让我感到很温暖。
examples.en: When I was sick, my classmates' care made me feel really warm inside.

examples.zh: 绿色象征着春天和活力。
examples.en: Green symbolizes spring and vitality.

examples.zh: 年轻人给这个小城带来了活力。
examples.en: Young people have brought new life to this small town.

examples.zh: 中秋节的月亮又大又圆。
examples.en: The moon at Mid-Autumn Festival is big and round.

examples.zh: 中国人吃饭喜欢用圆桌，一家人围着坐。
examples.en: Chinese people like to eat at round tables, with the whole family sitting around them.

examples.zh: 天上挂着一个弯弯的月亮。
examples.en: A crescent moon hangs in the sky.

examples.zh: 这条路有点儿弯。
examples.en: This road is a little winding.

examples.zh: 在一些国家，白色和死亡有关系。
examples.en: In some countries, white is associated with death.

examples.zh: 这次交通事故没有造成人员死亡。
examples.en: This traffic accident caused no deaths.

examples.zh: 中国朋友夸我汉语说得好，我说“哪里哪里”。
examples.en: My Chinese friend praised my Chinese, and I said, "Oh, not at all."

examples.zh: 老师夸他进步很大。
examples.en: The teacher praised him for making great progress.

examples.zh: 每个人对颜色的喜好都不一样。
examples.en: Everyone has different color preferences.

examples.zh: 送礼物之前，最好先了解对方的喜好。
examples.en: Before giving a gift, it's best to find out what the other person likes.

examples.zh: 很多中国人忌讳送钟，因为“送钟”听起来像“送终”。
examples.en: Many Chinese people avoid giving clocks as gifts, because 送钟 sounds like 送终 ("seeing someone off to death").

examples.zh: 在中国朋友家做客，有什么忌讳吗？
examples.en: Are there any taboos when visiting a Chinese friend's home?

examples.zh: 在古代中国，紫色是一种高贵的颜色。
examples.en: In ancient China, purple was a noble color.

examples.zh: 她今天穿了一件紫色的衣服。
examples.en: She is wearing a purple outfit today.

examples.zh: 他穿了一件红衣服，在人群里特别显眼。
examples.en: He wore a red top and really stood out in the crowd.

examples.zh: 我把通知贴在了门口最显眼的地方。
examples.en: I put the notice up in the most conspicuous spot by the door.

examples.zh: 知道我要来，她特意准备了一桌菜。
examples.en: Knowing I was coming, she specially prepared a whole table of dishes.

examples.zh: 我是特意来看你的，不是路过。
examples.en: I came specially to see you—I wasn't just passing by.

examples.zh: 中国的国旗是红色的，上面有五颗星。
examples.en: China's national flag is red with five stars on it.

examples.zh: 运动员拿着国旗走进了体育场。
examples.en: The athletes walked into the stadium carrying the national flag.

examples.zh: 放弃意味着失败。
examples.en: Giving up means failure.

examples.zh: 这次成功意味着我们的努力没有白费。
examples.en: This success means our efforts were worthwhile.

examples.zh: 在中国，红色象征喜庆和好运。
examples.en: In China, red symbolizes celebration and good luck.

examples.zh: 鸽子是和平的象征。
examples.en: The dove is a symbol of peace.

examples.zh: 春节的时候，人们互相说吉祥的话。
examples.en: At Spring Festival, people say auspicious words to one another.

examples.zh: 在中国文化里，龙是一种吉祥的动物。
examples.en: In Chinese culture, the dragon is an auspicious animal.

examples.zh: 过春节的时候，家家户户都贴红对联。
examples.en: At Spring Festival, every household puts up red couplets.

examples.zh: 我买了一副对联，想贴在宿舍门上。
examples.en: I bought a pair of couplets to put up on my dorm door.

examples.zh: 元宵节晚上，街上挂满了红灯笼。
examples.en: On the night of the Lantern Festival, the streets are hung with red lanterns.

examples.zh: 我们在手工课上学做了一个灯笼。
examples.en: We learned to make a lantern in craft class.

examples.zh: 毕业那天，我们依依不舍地告别了老师。
examples.en: On graduation day, we reluctantly said goodbye to our teachers.

examples.zh: 在中国，白色常常用在告别仪式上。
examples.en: In China, white is often used at funeral services.

examples.zh: 在古代，黄色是皇帝专用的高贵颜色。
examples.en: In ancient times, yellow was a noble color reserved for the emperor.

examples.zh: 她穿上这件衣服，显得很高贵。
examples.en: She looks very elegant and noble in this outfit.

examples.zh: 古代皇帝的权力非常大。
examples.en: Emperors in ancient times had enormous power.

examples.zh: 在古代，黄色象征着权力。
examples.en: In ancient times, yellow symbolized power.

examples.zh: 地上很凉，你坐在垫子上吧。
examples.en: The floor is cold—sit on the cushion.

examples.zh: 我买了一个软垫子放在椅子上。
examples.en: I bought a soft cushion for my chair.

examples.zh: 阳光下，金黄色的琉璃瓦闪闪发光。
examples.en: The golden glazed tiles glitter in the sunlight.

examples.zh: 故宫有很多黄色的琉璃瓦。
examples.en: The Forbidden City has many yellow glazed roof tiles.

examples.zh: 黑色给人一种严肃的感觉。
examples.en: Black gives people a sense of seriousness.

examples.zh: 老师今天的表情很严肃，大家都不敢说话。
examples.en: The teacher looked very serious today, so nobody dared to speak.

examples.zh: 京剧里的黑脸常常象征正直和正义。
examples.en: In Peking opera, a black-painted face often stands for integrity and justice.

examples.zh: 他是一个很有正义感的人。
examples.en: He has a strong sense of justice.

words.meaning: middle ten days of a month

examples.zh: 傣族的泼水节一般在四月中旬。
examples.en: The Dai Water-Splashing Festival usually falls in mid-April.

examples.zh: 这个月中旬我们就要考试了。
examples.en: We have exams in the middle of this month.

examples.zh: 下个月我们班要去云南考察少数民族文化。
examples.en: Next month our class is going to Yunnan to study ethnic minority cultures.

examples.zh: 他写了一份很详细的考察报告。
examples.en: He wrote a very detailed field-study report.

words.meaning: hold something level with both hands; carry

examples.zh: 傣族姑娘端着水盆，向客人泼水。
examples.en: Dai girls carrying basins of water splash the guests.

examples.zh: 服务员端上来一盘热腾腾的饺子。
examples.en: The waiter brought over a plate of steaming dumplings.

examples.zh: 水盆里放了很多花瓣，闻起来香香的。
examples.en: There were lots of petals in the basin, and it smelled lovely.

examples.zh: 风一吹，花瓣落了一地。
examples.en: When the wind blew, petals fell all over the ground.

examples.zh: 泼水节的场面热闹极了。
examples.en: The scene at the Water-Splashing Festival was incredibly lively.

examples.zh: 他第一次见到这么大的场面，有点儿紧张。
examples.en: It was his first time at such a big occasion, and he was a bit nervous.

examples.zh: 几千人一起泼水，场面非常壮观。
examples.en: Thousands of people splashing water together made a spectacular scene.

examples.zh: 站在长城上看日出，真壮观啊！
examples.en: Watching the sunrise from the Great Wall is truly magnificent!

examples.zh: 泼水节一般持续三到四天。
examples.en: The Water-Splashing Festival usually lasts three to four days.

examples.zh: 高温天气还会持续一个星期。
examples.en: The hot weather will continue for another week.

examples.zh: 我很快就意识到自己说错了话。
examples.en: I quickly realized I'd said the wrong thing.

examples.zh: 现在年轻人的环保意识越来越强。
examples.en: Young people's environmental awareness is getting stronger and stronger.

examples.zh: 我忘了带伞，被淋成了落汤鸡。
examples.en: I forgot my umbrella and got soaked like a drowned rat.

examples.zh: 才泼了五分钟水，大家都成了落汤鸡。
examples.en: After just five minutes of water-splashing, everyone was soaked to the skin.

examples.zh: 他往水枪里灌满了水，准备去泼水。
examples.en: He filled his water gun to the top, ready to go splashing.

examples.zh: 出门前，我先把水瓶灌满了热水。
examples.en: Before going out, I filled my bottle with hot water.

examples.zh: 傣族人认为，身上泼的水越多，就越幸福。
examples.en: The Dai believe that the more water gets splashed on you, the happier you'll be.

examples.zh: 他不小心把咖啡泼在了我的衣服上。
examples.en: He accidentally spilled coffee on my clothes.

examples.zh: 孩子们在河里玩儿，溅起一朵朵水花。
examples.en: The children were playing in the river, kicking up sprays of water.

examples.zh: 一条鱼跳出水面，溅起了很大的水花。
examples.en: A fish leapt out of the water and made a big splash.

examples.zh: 一场大雨把路上的脏东西都冲走了。
examples.en: A heavy rain washed all the dirt off the road.

examples.zh: 水果吃之前要用水冲干净。
examples.en: Rinse fruit clean before you eat it.

examples.zh: 泼完水，我浑身都是水。
examples.en: After the water-splashing, I was wet all over.

examples.zh: 他跑了一个小时步，浑身是汗。
examples.en: He ran for an hour and was dripping with sweat.

examples.zh: 下了一场大雨，我的衣服全湿透了。
examples.en: There was a downpour, and my clothes got completely soaked.

examples.zh: 快把湿透的鞋换下来，别感冒了。
examples.en: Change out of those soaked shoes quickly so you don't catch a cold.

examples.zh: 听到好消息，大家都兴高采烈。
examples.en: Everyone was in high spirits when they heard the good news.

examples.zh: 孩子们兴高采烈地去春游。
examples.en: The children went on their spring outing in high spirits.

examples.zh: 我们和傣族朋友一起庆祝泼水节。
examples.en: We celebrated the Water-Splashing Festival with our Dai friends.

examples.zh: 考试结束了，我们去吃火锅庆祝一下吧！
examples.en: Exams are over—let's go have hotpot to celebrate!

examples.zh: 西双版纳傣族自治州位于云南省。
examples.en: Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture is in Yunnan Province.

examples.zh: 西双版纳傣族自治州的泼水节很有名。
examples.en: Xishuangbanna Dai Autonomous Prefecture is famous for its Water-Splashing Festival.

examples.zh: 泼水节期间，人们互相泼水送祝福。
examples.en: During the Water-Splashing Festival, people splash water on one another to send good wishes.

examples.zh: 我们想去参加一次泼水节。
examples.en: We want to take part in a Water-Splashing Festival.

examples.zh: 泼泥节上，人们互相往身上抹泥，祝福对方健康。
examples.en: At the Mud-Splashing Festival, people smear mud on each other to wish one another good health.

examples.zh: 参加完泼泥节，我们每个人都成了“泥人”。
examples.en: After the Mud-Splashing Festival, every one of us had turned into a "mud person".

examples.zh: 关于泼水节，有一个美丽的传说。
examples.en: There's a beautiful legend about the Water-Splashing Festival.

examples.zh: 传说月亮上住着一位仙女，叫嫦娥。
examples.en: Legend has it that a fairy named Chang'e lives on the moon.

examples.zh: 今年雨水多，庄稼长得特别好。
examples.en: There was plenty of rain this year, so the crops grew especially well.

examples.zh: 农民们正在地里收庄稼。
examples.en: The farmers are harvesting the crops in the fields.

examples.zh: 阳光和水对植物的生长很重要。
examples.en: Sunlight and water are important for plant growth.

examples.zh: 这种花只生长在南方。
examples.en: This flower only grows in the south.

examples.zh: 传说中，七个姑娘一起想办法杀死了火魔。
examples.en: In the legend, seven girls worked together to kill the fire demon.

examples.zh: 我不敢杀鱼，每次都请老板帮我杀。
examples.en: I'm afraid to kill fish, so I always ask the vendor to do it for me.

words.meaning: take advantage of; while (there's a chance)

examples.zh: 趁天还没黑，我们赶紧下山吧。
examples.en: Let's hurry down the mountain while it's still light.

examples.zh: 趁年轻，多出去走走看看。
examples.en: Travel and see the world while you're young.

examples.zh: 天冷了，出门记得把脖子围上。
examples.en: It's getting cold—remember to wrap up your neck when you go out.

examples.zh: 我看了一天电脑，脖子特别疼。
examples.en: I stared at the computer all day, and my neck really hurts.

examples.zh: 球滚到桌子底下去了。
examples.en: The ball rolled under the table.

examples.zh: 小狗在草地上滚来滚去。
examples.en: The puppy rolled around on the grass.

examples.zh: 泼水节也是为了纪念那七位勇敢的姑娘。
examples.en: The Water-Splashing Festival also commemorates those seven brave girls.

examples.zh: 这张照片很有纪念意义，我一直留着。
examples.en: This photo means a lot to me, so I've always kept it.

examples.zh: 节日里，人们一边敲鼓一边跳舞。
examples.en: During the festival, people dance while beating drums.

examples.zh: 他打鼓打得特别好。
examples.en: He plays the drums really well.

examples.zh: 他送给她一块玉，作为爱情的信物。
examples.en: He gave her a piece of jade as a token of his love.

examples.zh: 这枚戒指是他们的定情信物。
examples.en: This ring is the love token they exchanged.

examples.zh: 万圣节那天，她打扮成了一个女巫。
examples.en: On Halloween, she dressed up as a witch.

examples.zh: 童话里的女巫常常住在森林里。
examples.en: Witches in fairy tales often live in the forest.

examples.zh: 神父在教堂主持仪式。
examples.en: The priest conducted the ceremony in the church.

examples.zh: 这位神父在中国住了二十年，中文说得很流利。
examples.en: This priest has lived in China for twenty years and speaks fluent Chinese.

examples.zh: 斋月期间，穆斯林白天要封斋。
examples.en: During Ramadan, Muslims fast during the day.

examples.zh: 我的同学在封斋，所以中午不跟我们一起吃饭。
examples.en: My classmate is fasting, so he doesn't have lunch with us.

lessons.title: 原来筷子有这么多讲究

examples.zh: 这个小长假我们去郊外玩。
examples.en: We'll go to the countryside during this long weekend.

examples.zh: 小长假期间火车票很难买。
examples.en: Train tickets are hard to get during a short holiday.

words.meaning: conveniently; while one is at it

examples.zh: 他洗完自己的碗，顺手把我的也洗了。
examples.en: After washing his own bowl, he washed mine too while he was at it.

examples.zh: 你去超市的话，顺手帮我买瓶水吧。
examples.en: If you're going to the supermarket, could you grab me a bottle of water while you're there?

examples.zh: 吃饭的时候，不要把筷子插在米饭上。
examples.en: At meals, don't stick your chopsticks upright in your rice.

examples.zh: 大家正在讨论，他突然插了一句话。
examples.en: Everyone was in the middle of a discussion when he suddenly cut in.

words.meaning: etiquette; particular custom; be particular about

examples.zh: 原来中国人用筷子有这么多讲究。
examples.en: So there's so much etiquette to using chopsticks in China!

examples.zh: 这家饭馆很讲究，连筷子都是特别定做的。
examples.en: This restaurant pays great attention to detail—even the chopsticks are custom-made.

examples.zh: 日本的筷子比较短，头儿是尖的。
examples.en: Japanese chopsticks are shorter and have pointed tips.

examples.zh: 这支铅笔太尖了，小心扎手。
examples.en: This pencil is very sharp—careful not to prick your hand.

examples.zh: 他用筷子把菜里的辣椒都挑了出来。
examples.en: He used his chopsticks to pick all the chili peppers out of the dish.

examples.zh: 吃鱼时要小心挑鱼刺。
examples.en: Be careful to pick out the fish bones when eating fish.

examples.zh: 吃鱼的时候，我被一根鱼刺卡住了。
examples.en: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat while eating fish.

examples.zh: 这种鱼鱼刺很多，孩子吃的时候要小心。
examples.en: This kind of fish has lots of bones, so kids need to be careful when eating it.

words.meaning: serving individual portions (each diner has their own plate)

examples.zh: 西方人吃饭一般采用分餐制。
examples.en: Westerners generally eat with individual portions.

examples.zh: 这家学校食堂采用分餐制。
examples.en: This school cafeteria serves individual portions.

words.meaning: press from both sides; pick up with chopsticks

examples.zh: 中国人吃饭时喜欢给客人夹菜。
examples.en: At meals, Chinese people like to put food on their guests' plates with chopsticks.

examples.zh: 我用筷子还夹不起花生米。
examples.en: I still can't pick up peanuts with chopsticks.

examples.zh: 韩国人习惯用金属筷子。
examples.en: Koreans usually use metal chopsticks.

examples.zh: 微波炉里不能放金属的东西。
examples.en: You can't put metal objects in a microwave.

examples.zh: 小心，地上有碎玻璃。
examples.en: Careful, there's broken glass on the floor.

examples.zh: 我买了一套玻璃杯送给同屋。
examples.en: I bought a set of glasses for my roommate.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆的餐具都是消过毒的。
examples.en: All the tableware in this restaurant has been sterilized.

examples.zh: 不同国家使用的餐具不一样。
examples.en: Different countries use different eating utensils.

examples.zh: 以前，用筷子敲碗被认为像乞丐要饭一样。
examples.en: In the past, tapping your bowl with chopsticks was considered like a beggar begging for food.

examples.zh: 街边有一个乞丐在要钱。
examples.en: There's a beggar asking for money by the side of the street.

examples.zh: 路上的行人都停下来看热闹。
examples.en: The pedestrians on the road all stopped to watch.

examples.zh: 开车经过路口时，要注意行人。
examples.en: When driving through an intersection, watch out for pedestrians.

examples.zh: 爷爷常说，以前的日子过得很苦。
examples.en: Grandpa often says life used to be very hard.

examples.zh: 结婚以后，两个人要好好过日子。
examples.en: Once married, the two of them should build a good life together.

examples.zh: 到了新的国家，要学会入乡随俗。
examples.en: When you arrive in a new country, you should adapt to local customs.

examples.zh: 去朋友家做客也应该入乡随俗。
examples.en: When visiting a friend's home, you should respect their customs too.

examples.zh: 他连续工作了十个小时，太累了。
examples.en: He worked ten hours straight and is exhausted.

examples.zh: 我们队连续赢了三场比赛。
examples.en: Our team won three games in a row.

examples.zh: 快下雨了，我们赶紧回家吧。
examples.en: It's about to rain—let's hurry home.

examples.zh: 水开了，赶紧把饺子放进去。
examples.en: The water's boiling—put the dumplings in quickly.

examples.zh: 我只会煮方便面。
examples.en: All I know how to cook is instant noodles.

examples.zh: 鸡蛋煮十分钟就熟了。
examples.en: Eggs are done after boiling for ten minutes.

examples.zh: 传说大禹用树枝夹起了锅里的热肉。
examples.en: Legend says Yu the Great used twigs to pick up hot meat from the pot.

examples.zh: 下雪以后，树枝上全是白的。
examples.en: After the snow, the branches were all white.

examples.zh: 这双筷子太细了，不好用。
examples.en: These chopsticks are too thin to use easily.

examples.zh: 她把土豆切成了很细的丝。
examples.en: She cut the potato into very fine shreds.

examples.zh: 他对中国文化产生了很大的兴趣。
examples.en: He developed a great interest in Chinese culture.

examples.zh: 文化不同，容易产生误会。
examples.en: Cultural differences easily give rise to misunderstandings.

examples.zh: 竹子的用途很多，可以做筷子，也可以做家具。
examples.en: Bamboo has many uses—you can make chopsticks and furniture out of it.

examples.zh: 这个小工具有什么用途？
examples.en: What is this little gadget used for?

examples.zh: 他剥了一个橘子给我吃。
examples.en: He peeled a tangerine for me.

examples.zh: 吃虾的时候，要先把皮剥掉。
examples.en: When eating shrimp, you have to peel off the shell first.

examples.zh: 吃完饭，服务员给每个人拿了一根牙签。
examples.en: After the meal, the waiter gave everyone a toothpick.

examples.zh: 他用牙签插了一块西瓜。
examples.en: He speared a piece of watermelon with a toothpick.

examples.zh: 他是被抬进医院的，可见病得很重。
examples.en: He had to be carried into hospital, which shows how seriously ill he was.

examples.zh: 路上全是水，可见昨晚下过大雨。
examples.en: The road is covered in water, so it clearly rained heavily last night.

examples.zh: 我的宿舍朝南，阳光很好。
examples.en: My dorm faces south and gets lots of sunlight.

examples.zh: 吃饭时，筷子不要朝着别人。
examples.en: At the table, don't point your chopsticks at other people.

examples.zh: 吃饭时，要让年长的人先动筷子。
examples.en: At meals, let the older people start eating first.

examples.zh: 他是我们班最年长的学生。
examples.en: He's the oldest student in our class.

examples.zh: 主人一直给我夹菜，表示他的诚意。
examples.en: The host kept putting food on my plate to show his sincerity.

examples.zh: 如果你真有诚意，就应该当面道歉。
examples.en: If you're really sincere, you should apologize in person.

examples.zh: 这座四合院已经有一百多年历史了。
examples.en: This courtyard house is more than a hundred years old.

examples.zh: 北京还有一些保存完好的四合院。
examples.en: Beijing still has some well-preserved traditional courtyard houses.

examples.zh: 自从搬进四合院以后，我认识了很多邻居。
examples.en: Since moving into the courtyard house, I've gotten to know a lot of neighbors.

examples.zh: 自从来到中国，他每天练习汉语。
examples.en: Since coming to China, he has practiced Chinese every day.

examples.zh: 大家夸他讲得好，他笑着说：“不敢当。”
examples.en: Everyone praised his speech, and he smiled and said, "I'm flattered."

examples.zh: “不敢当”是一种谦虚的回答。
examples.en: I'm flattered is a modest way to respond to praise.

examples.zh: 中国人听到夸奖时，常常会谦虚一下。
examples.en: When Chinese people are praised, they often respond modestly.

examples.zh: 他成绩很好，可是一点儿也不骄傲，很谦虚。
examples.en: He gets great grades but isn't arrogant at all—he's very modest.

examples.zh: 这座大杂院里住着好几户人家。
examples.en: Several households live in this shared residential courtyard.

examples.zh: 过去有些家庭住在大杂院里。
examples.en: In the past, some families lived in shared courtyard compounds.

examples.zh: 来中国半年，我逐渐习惯了这里的生活。
examples.en: After half a year in China, I've gradually gotten used to life here.

examples.zh: 天气逐渐暖和起来了。
examples.en: The weather is gradually getting warmer.

examples.zh: 现在还有一些老人居住在四合院里。
examples.en: Some elderly people still live in courtyard houses.

examples.zh: 这个小区的居住环境很不错。
examples.en: The living environment in this residential complex is very good.

examples.zh: 四合院的结构很有特点。
examples.en: The structure of a courtyard house is very distinctive.

examples.zh: 这个句子的结构有点儿复杂。
examples.en: The structure of this sentence is a bit complicated.

examples.zh: 四合院已经成为老北京的文化符号。
examples.en: Courtyard houses have become a cultural symbol of old Beijing.

examples.zh: 这个符号是什么意思？
examples.en: What does this symbol mean?

examples.zh: 这个传统已经延续了几百年。
examples.en: This tradition has continued for hundreds of years.

examples.zh: 我们希望把老北京的生活方式延续下去。
examples.en: We hope to keep the old Beijing way of life going.

examples.zh: 这几年，北京的空气污染得到了治理。
examples.en: In recent years, Beijing's air pollution has been brought under control.

examples.zh: 政府正在治理这条河。
examples.en: The government is cleaning up this river.

examples.zh: 维护古建筑需要很多钱。
examples.en: Maintaining historic buildings costs a lot of money.

examples.zh: 大家都应该维护公共场所的卫生。
examples.en: Everyone should help keep public places clean.

examples.zh: 天安门是北京的标志。
examples.en: Tiananmen is the symbol of Beijing.

examples.zh: 开车时一定要注意交通标志。
examples.en: Always pay attention to traffic signs when driving.

examples.zh: 这座四合院已经被列为文物保护单位。
examples.en: This courtyard house has been listed as a protected heritage site.

examples.zh: 博物馆里有很多珍贵的文物。
examples.en: The museum has many precious cultural relics.

examples.zh: 很多四合院被改建成了酒店和咖啡馆。
examples.en: Many courtyard houses have been converted into hotels and cafés.

examples.zh: 学校的老图书馆正在改建。
examples.en: The school's old library is being renovated.

examples.zh: 住在四合院里，邻居之间也有一些老规矩。
examples.en: Living in a courtyard house, the neighbors also follow some old unwritten rules.

examples.zh: 去别人家做客，要懂点儿规矩。
examples.en: When you visit someone's home, you should know some basic manners.

examples.zh: 这座四合院保存得非常完整。
examples.en: This courtyard house is extremely well preserved.

examples.zh: 请用完整的句子回答问题。
examples.en: Please answer the questions in complete sentences.

examples.zh: 有些菜只在特定的节日才吃。
examples.en: Some dishes are only eaten at specific festivals.

examples.zh: 在特定情况下，可以申请推迟考试。
examples.en: Under specific circumstances, you can apply to postpone an exam.

examples.zh: 今天又来了一批外国游客参观四合院。
examples.en: Another group of foreign tourists came to visit the courtyard house today.

examples.zh: 图书馆新到了一大批书。
examples.en: The library has just received a big batch of new books.

examples.zh: 老四合院的生活设施不太方便。
examples.en: The living facilities in old courtyard houses aren't very convenient.

examples.zh: 这个公园的公共设施很齐全。
examples.en: This park has a full range of public facilities.

examples.zh: 这座四合院是私人的，不能随便参观。
examples.en: This courtyard house is privately owned—you can't just walk in and look around.

examples.zh: 对不起，这是我的私人问题，我不想回答。
examples.en: Sorry, that's a personal matter; I'd rather not answer.

examples.zh: 维修老房子对普通家庭来说是很大的负担。
examples.en: Repairing an old house is a heavy burden for an ordinary family.

examples.zh: 我不想给父母增加经济负担。
examples.en: I don't want to add to my parents' financial burden.

examples.zh: 四合院是一种比较封闭的建筑。
examples.en: The courtyard house is a fairly enclosed type of building.

examples.zh: 这条路正在修，暂时封闭了。
examples.en: This road is under repair and temporarily closed.

examples.zh: 政府想把这条胡同恢复成原来的样子。
examples.en: The government wants to restore this hutong to its original appearance.

examples.zh: 休息了几天，他的身体恢复得很好。
examples.en: After a few days' rest, he's recovered well.

examples.zh: 保护四合院需要采取有效的手段。
examples.en: Protecting courtyard houses requires effective measures.

examples.zh: 网络已经成为一种重要的教学手段。
examples.en: The internet has become an important teaching tool.

examples.zh: 拆不拆老房子，一直有很大争议。
examples.en: Whether or not to tear down old houses has always been very controversial.

examples.zh: 这个问题还存在争议，大家看法不同。
examples.en: This issue is still disputed; people see it differently.

examples.zh: 我想尝试一下住在四合院里是什么感觉。
examples.en: I'd like to try living in a courtyard house to see what it's like.

examples.zh: 失败了也没关系，我们可以再尝试一次。
examples.en: It doesn't matter if we fail; we can try again.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆的辣子鸡丁很受欢迎。
examples.en: The spicy diced chicken at this restaurant is popular.

examples.zh: 辣子鸡丁太辣了，我吃了一口就开始找水喝。
examples.en: The spicy diced chicken was so hot that after one bite I went looking for water.

examples.zh: 我爸爸很擅长做饭，特别是川菜。
examples.en: My dad is great at cooking, especially Sichuan food.

examples.zh: 你擅长什么运动？
examples.en: What sports are you good at?

examples.zh: 她丈夫很体贴，每天都帮她做家务。
examples.en: Her husband is very considerate and helps her with the housework every day.

examples.zh: 他对女朋友一点儿也不体贴。
examples.en: He isn't considerate toward his girlfriend at all.

examples.zh: 在我们家，爸爸和妈妈一起做家务。
examples.en: In our family, Dad and Mom do the housework together.

examples.zh: 周末我要洗衣服、打扫房间，家务太多了。
examples.en: On weekends I have to do laundry and clean my room—there are too many chores.

words.meaning: worries about things back home; domestic concerns

examples.zh: 有父母帮忙照顾孩子，她工作没有后顾之忧。
examples.en: With her parents helping look after the kids, she can work without worrying about home.

examples.zh: 学校帮留学生解决了住宿问题，大家就没有后顾之忧了。
examples.en: The school sorted out housing for international students, so they have nothing to worry about.

examples.zh: 他们俩工作都很忙，就请了一个保姆。
examples.en: They're both busy with work, so they hired a nanny.

examples.zh: 我们家的保姆做饭特别好吃。
examples.en: Our housekeeper is a really good cook.

examples.zh: 他觉得男子汉大丈夫应该承担责任。
examples.en: He thinks a real man should take responsibility.

examples.zh: 男子汉大丈夫，哭什么！
examples.en: A grown man like you—what are you crying for?

examples.zh: 父母都希望孩子将来有出息。
examples.en: All parents hope their children will make something of themselves.

examples.zh: 这么小的困难就放弃，真没出息！
examples.en: Giving up over such a small difficulty—how spineless!

examples.zh: 他不赞成大男子主义。
examples.en: He doesn't agree with male chauvinism.

examples.zh: 大男子主义容易影响夫妻沟通。
examples.en: Male chauvinism can easily harm communication between spouses.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩应该一起承担家务。
examples.en: Husband and wife should share the housework.

examples.zh: 这件事是我的错，我来承担责任。
examples.en: This is my fault; I'll take responsibility.

examples.zh: 做饭对我来说是一种乐趣。
examples.en: To me, cooking is a pleasure.

examples.zh: 学汉语给我带来了很多乐趣。
examples.en: Learning Chinese has brought me a lot of joy.

words.meaning: kill two birds with one stone

examples.zh: 骑车上班既省钱又锻炼身体，真是一举两得。
examples.en: Cycling to work saves money and gives you exercise—two benefits at once.

examples.zh: 一边旅游一边学汉语，可以一举两得。
examples.en: Traveling while learning Chinese lets you achieve two goals at once.

examples.zh: 遇到问题不能总是逃避。
examples.en: You can't always run away from problems.

examples.zh: 他找各种理由逃避做家务。
examples.en: He makes all sorts of excuses to get out of doing housework.

examples.zh: 她常常抱怨丈夫不做家务。
examples.en: She often complains that her husband doesn't do any housework.

examples.zh: 别总是抱怨了，想想办法吧。
examples.en: Stop complaining all the time and think of a solution.

examples.zh: 这次作业的要求很明确。
examples.en: The requirements for this assignment are very clear.

examples.zh: 我们先明确一下每个人的任务。
examples.en: Let's first make clear what each person's task is.

words.meaning: divide the work; division of labor

examples.zh: 我们宿舍打扫卫生的分工很明确。
examples.en: The cleaning duties in our dorm are clearly divided.

examples.zh: 夫妻俩分工合作，一个做饭，一个洗碗。
examples.en: The couple divide the work: one cooks and the other washes up.

examples.zh: 朋友之间不要太计较。
examples.en: Friends shouldn't be too petty with each other.

examples.zh: 他从来不计较谁多做了一点儿家务。
examples.en: He never fusses over who did a bit more housework.

examples.zh: 他很自觉，吃完饭就去洗碗。
examples.en: He's very self-motivated—he goes to wash the dishes right after eating.

examples.zh: 学习要靠自觉，别人催是没有用的。
examples.en: Studying depends on self-discipline; it's no use others nagging you.

examples.zh: 加班是家常便饭。
examples.en: Working overtime is an everyday occurrence.

examples.zh: 对留学生来说，说错话是家常便饭。
examples.en: For international students, saying the wrong thing is an everyday occurrence.

examples.zh: 语言已经不再是我们交流的障碍了。
examples.en: Language is no longer a barrier to our communication.

examples.zh: 刚来中国的时候，我遇到了很多障碍。
examples.en: When I first came to China, I ran into many obstacles.

examples.zh: 事情已经发生了，互相埋怨也没有用。
examples.en: It's already happened—blaming each other is no use.

examples.zh: 她埋怨我没早点儿告诉她。
examples.en: She blamed me for not telling her sooner.

examples.zh: 他很勤快，每天早上都打扫房间。
examples.en: He's very hardworking and cleans his room every morning.

examples.zh: 你要是勤快一点儿，房间就不会这么乱了。
examples.en: If you were a bit more diligent, your room wouldn't be such a mess.

examples.zh: 女儿一撒娇，爸爸就什么都答应了。
examples.en: As soon as his daughter acts cute, her dad agrees to anything.

examples.zh: 你都这么大了，别撒娇了。
examples.en: You're all grown up now—stop acting like a spoiled child.

examples.zh: 人家已经说了不去，你别再劝了。
examples.en: They've already said they won't go; stop trying to persuade them.

examples.zh: 人家还没准备好呢！
examples.en: I'm not ready yet!

examples.zh: 我和同屋轮流打扫房间。
examples.en: My roommate and I take turns cleaning the room.

examples.zh: 周末我们家轮流做饭，这周轮到我了。
examples.en: In our family we take turns cooking on weekends, and this week it's my turn.

examples.zh: 这个学期我过得很充实。
examples.en: This semester has been very fulfilling for me.

examples.zh: 这本书的内容很充实。
examples.en: This book has very substantial content.

examples.zh: 我的快递到了，我下楼取一下。
examples.en: My package has arrived; I'll go downstairs to pick it up.

examples.zh: 在中国，快递一般两三天就到。
examples.en: In China, deliveries usually arrive in two or three days.

examples.zh: 双十一的时候，很多网店都在搞促销活动。
examples.en: Around Singles' Day, lots of online stores run promotions.

examples.zh: 我们班想搞一次调查，了解大家的网购习惯。
examples.en: Our class wants to do a survey about everyone's online shopping habits.

examples.zh: 这家超市正在促销，水果打八折。
examples.en: This supermarket is having a sale—fruit is 20% off.

examples.zh: 很多人等到促销的时候才买东西。
examples.en: Many people wait for a promotion before buying things.

examples.zh: 她在网上买了很多化妆品。
examples.en: She bought lots of cosmetics online.

examples.zh: 买化妆品之前，最好先看看别人的评价。
examples.en: Before buying cosmetics, it's best to read other people's reviews.

examples.zh: 现在很多年轻人在电商公司工作。
examples.en: Many young people now work at e-commerce companies.

examples.zh: 电商的发展改变了人们的购物习惯。
examples.en: The growth of e-commerce has changed people's shopping habits.

examples.zh: 这家公司的物流很快，第二天就到了。
examples.en: This company's logistics are fast—it arrived the next day.

examples.zh: 我哥哥在一家物流公司上班。
examples.en: My brother works at a logistics company.

examples.zh: 中国的物流非常发达，网购很方便。
examples.en: China's logistics are highly developed, so online shopping is very convenient.

examples.zh: 这个城市的交通很发达。
examples.en: This city has a well-developed transport network.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上下单，今天上午就收到了。
examples.en: I placed the order last night and got it this morning.

examples.zh: 下单之前，先看看有没有优惠券。
examples.en: Before placing an order, check whether there are any coupons.

examples.zh: 用这张优惠券可以便宜二十块。
examples.en: This coupon gets you twenty yuan off.

examples.zh: 很多网店会给新顾客送优惠券。
examples.en: Many online stores give coupons to new customers.

examples.zh: 网购的售后服务越来越健全了。
examples.en: After-sales service for online shopping is getting more and more robust.

examples.zh: 这个小区的设施很健全。
examples.en: This residential complex has a full set of facilities.

examples.zh: 很多网店支持七天无理由退货。
examples.en: Many online stores accept returns within seven days, no reason needed.

examples.zh: 你不来上课的理由是什么？
examples.en: What's your reason for not coming to class?

examples.zh: 快递把东西弄坏了，我要向他们索赔。
examples.en: The courier damaged my package, so I'm going to claim compensation from them.

examples.zh: 如果商品有问题，你可以提出索赔。
examples.en: If the product is faulty, you can file a claim for compensation.

examples.zh: 买东西以前，我习惯先看看顾客的评价。
examples.en: Before buying something, I usually check the customer reviews first.

examples.zh: 老师对我的作文评价很高。
examples.en: The teacher gave my essay a very high assessment.

examples.zh: 打折的诱惑太大了，我又买了很多东西。
examples.en: The lure of discounts was too strong—I bought loads of stuff again.

examples.zh: 别被广告诱惑，买自己真正需要的。
examples.en: Don't be tempted by ads; buy what you really need.

examples.zh: 买这台电脑，还送一个鼠标作为赠品。
examples.en: Buy this computer and you get a free mouse.

examples.zh: 有些人买东西就是为了那些赠品。
examples.en: Some people buy things just for the free gifts.

examples.zh: 我更喜欢去实体店买衣服，因为可以试穿。
examples.en: I prefer buying clothes in physical stores because I can try them on.

examples.zh: 网购让很多实体店的生意变差了。
examples.en: Online shopping has hurt business at many brick-and-mortar stores.

examples.zh: 他特别喜欢数码产品，新手机一出来就买。
examples.en: He loves digital gadgets and buys every new phone as soon as it comes out.

examples.zh: 现在用数码相机的人越来越少了。
examples.en: Fewer and fewer people use digital cameras these days.

examples.zh: 网购带动了快递行业的发展。
examples.en: Online shopping has driven the growth of the express-delivery industry.

examples.zh: 你将来想在哪个行业工作？
examples.en: Which industry do you want to work in in the future?

examples.zh: 我对比了几家网店的价格，这家最便宜。
examples.en: I compared prices at several online stores, and this one is the cheapest.

examples.zh: 和十年前对比，现在的生活方便多了。
examples.en: Compared with ten years ago, life is much more convenient now.

examples.zh: 在网上逛着逛着，不知不觉就到了半夜。
examples.en: I kept browsing online, and before I knew it, it was midnight.

examples.zh: 不知不觉，我来中国已经一年了。
examples.en: Before I knew it, I'd been in China for a whole year.

examples.zh: 网购的东西包装得太严实了，我拆了半天。
examples.en: The online order was packaged so tightly that it took me ages to open.

examples.zh: 麻烦您帮我包装一下，我要送人。
examples.en: Could you wrap it up for me, please? It's a gift.

examples.zh: 网购对实体店产生了很大的冲击。
examples.en: Online shopping has had a huge impact on physical stores.

examples.zh: 刚来中国时，我受到了不小的文化冲击。
examples.en: When I first came to China, I experienced quite a culture shock.

examples.zh: 商家千方百计吸引顾客购买。
examples.en: Merchants do everything they can to get customers to buy.

examples.zh: 为了学好汉语，他千方百计找中国人聊天。
examples.en: To learn Chinese well, he does everything possible to chat with Chinese people.

examples.zh: 我想体验一下中国的农村生活。
examples.en: I'd like to experience rural life in China.

examples.zh: 第一次用手机付款，是一种很新鲜的体验。
examples.en: Paying with my phone for the first time was a novel experience.

examples.zh: 他聚精会神地看着手机，连我叫他都没听见。
examples.en: He was so absorbed in his phone that he didn't even hear me call him.

examples.zh: 上课的时候，大家都聚精会神地听老师讲。
examples.en: In class, everyone listened intently to the teacher.

words.meaning: originally; at that time; in the first place

examples.zh: 当初来中国的时候，我一句汉语也不会说。
examples.en: When I first came to China, I couldn't say a word of Chinese.

examples.zh: 早知道这样，当初就不该买这么多。
examples.en: Had I known, I wouldn't have bought so much in the first place.

examples.zh: 在中国，很多人都用手机支付。
examples.en: In China, lots of people pay with their phones.

examples.zh: 现在买菜都可以扫码支付了。
examples.en: These days you can even scan a QR code to pay for groceries.

examples.zh: 现在很多人太依赖手机了。
examples.en: Nowadays many people rely too much on their phones.

examples.zh: 他已经长大了，不能总是依赖父母。
examples.en: He's grown up now and can't always depend on his parents.

examples.zh: 指南针、火药、造纸术和印刷术是中国古代的四大发明。
examples.en: The compass, gunpowder, papermaking and printing are the Four Great Inventions of ancient China.

examples.zh: 有人说，移动支付是中国的“新四大发明”之一。
examples.en: Some people say mobile payment is one of China's "Four New Great Inventions."

examples.zh: 天气预报说今天有雨，果然下了。
examples.en: The forecast said it would rain today, and sure enough, it did.

examples.zh: 大家都说这家店的菜好吃，我尝了尝，果然不错。
examples.en: Everyone says the food here is good; I tried it, and it really is.

examples.zh: 用现金付款，我心里更踏实一些。
examples.en: Paying in cash makes me feel more at ease.

examples.zh: 他做事很踏实，大家都放心交给他。
examples.en: He's very steady in his work, so everyone trusts him with things.

examples.zh: 千万别在陌生网站上泄露你的密码。
examples.en: Never reveal your password on unfamiliar websites.

examples.zh: 很多人担心手机支付会泄露个人信息。
examples.en: Many people worry that mobile payment may leak their personal information.

examples.zh: 扫码之前，要注意保护自己的隐私。
examples.en: Before scanning a code, be careful to protect your privacy.

examples.zh: 随便看别人的手机是不尊重隐私的。
examples.en: Looking at someone's phone without asking disrespects their privacy.

examples.zh: 用正规的支付软件，资金安全更有保障。
examples.en: If you use a legitimate payment app, your money is better protected.

examples.zh: 法律保障每个消费者的合法权益。
examples.en: The law safeguards every consumer's legal rights.

examples.zh: 最近总有人打电话向我推销保险。
examples.en: Lately people keep calling to sell me insurance.

examples.zh: 那个推销员一直在商场门口发传单。
examples.en: That salesperson has been handing out flyers at the mall entrance all day.

examples.zh: 孩子毕竟年纪小，不懂事。
examples.en: After all, the child is still young and doesn't know any better.

examples.zh: 别着急，他毕竟刚来中国，还不会用手机支付。
examples.en: Be patient—after all, he's just arrived in China and can't use mobile payment yet.

examples.zh: 中国的移动支付技术非常先进。
examples.en: China's mobile payment technology is very advanced.

examples.zh: 这家医院引进了很多先进的设备。
examples.en: This hospital has brought in a lot of advanced equipment.

examples.zh: 以往出门一定要带钱包，现在带手机就够了。
examples.en: In the past you had to bring your wallet when going out; now your phone is enough.

examples.zh: 今年的游客比以往多了很多。
examples.en: There are many more tourists this year than in previous years.

examples.zh: 现在买东西全靠一部手机。
examples.en: These days shopping depends entirely on one phone.

examples.zh: 他上大学的学费是靠自己打工挣的。
examples.en: He paid his university tuition with money he earned from part-time work.

examples.zh: 在北京，很多年轻人已经很少用纸币了。
examples.en: In Beijing, many young people rarely use banknotes anymore.

examples.zh: 这张纸币太旧了，自动售货机不收。
examples.en: This banknote is too worn—the vending machine won't take it.

examples.zh: 听说纸币上有很多细菌。
examples.en: I've heard there are lots of bacteria on banknotes.

examples.zh: 吃饭前洗手可以减少细菌。
examples.en: Washing your hands before eating reduces bacteria.

examples.zh: 路边的水果摊也可以扫码付款。
examples.en: Even the roadside fruit stall accepts payment by scanning a code.

examples.zh: 夜市里有好几十个小吃摊，热闹极了。
examples.en: There are dozens of snack stalls at the night market—it's really lively.

examples.zh: 陌生人发来的链接，不要轻易点开。
examples.en: Don't casually open links sent by strangers.

examples.zh: 他做了决定，就不会轻易改变。
examples.en: Once he makes a decision, he won't change it easily.

examples.zh: 我想去银行把美元兑换成人民币。
examples.en: I'd like to go to the bank to exchange US dollars for RMB.

examples.zh: 机场也能兑换外币，但是手续费比较高。
examples.en: You can also exchange foreign currency at the airport, but the fee is rather high.

examples.zh: 最近人民币的汇率变动很大。
examples.en: The RMB exchange rate has been fluctuating a lot recently.

examples.zh: 今天的汇率是多少？我想换点儿钱。
examples.en: What's the exchange rate today? I want to change some money.

examples.zh: 他的支付密码被盗了，损失了两千块钱。
examples.en: His payment password was stolen and he lost 2,000 yuan.

examples.zh: 这次台风给当地造成了很大的损失。
examples.en: This typhoon caused heavy losses to the area.

examples.zh: 付款成功以后，手机上会显示“支付成功”。
examples.en: After the payment goes through, your phone displays "Payment successful."

examples.zh: 调查显示，大部分年轻人更喜欢手机支付。
examples.en: Surveys show that most young people prefer mobile payment.

examples.zh: 有了手机支付，我终于摆脱了找零钱的麻烦。
examples.en: With mobile payment, I've finally got rid of the hassle of dealing with change.

examples.zh: 他想尽快摆脱对父母的经济依赖。
examples.en: He wants to free himself from financial dependence on his parents as soon as possible.

examples.zh: 我妈妈去年退休了，现在每天都很忙。
examples.en: My mom retired last year and now she's busy every day.

examples.zh: 中国的退休年龄可能会慢慢提高。
examples.en: China's retirement age may gradually be raised.

examples.zh: 小区楼下每天晚上都有人跳广场舞。
examples.en: Every evening people do square dancing downstairs in our neighborhood.

examples.zh: 广场舞的音乐太响，有些邻居很有意见。
examples.en: The square-dancing music is too loud, and some neighbors complain about it.

examples.zh: 刚退休的时候，妈妈觉得生活很空虚。
examples.en: When she first retired, Mom felt her life was empty.

examples.zh: 他每天玩游戏，其实是因为心里空虚。
examples.en: He plays games every day, really because he feels empty inside.

examples.zh: 她总嫌我房间太乱。
examples.en: She's always complaining that my room is too messy.

examples.zh: 我不想坐地铁，嫌人太多。
examples.en: I don't want to take the subway—I can't stand the crowds.

examples.zh: 妈妈一见到我就唠叨个没完。
examples.en: As soon as Mom sees me, she nags endlessly.

examples.zh: 别嫌爸妈唠叨，他们是关心你。
examples.en: Don't mind your parents' nagging—they care about you.

examples.zh: 孩子长大了，翅膀硬了，想自己做决定。
examples.en: The kid has grown up and become independent, and wants to make his own decisions.

examples.zh: 他刚工作就觉得自己翅膀硬了。
examples.en: He's only just started working and already thinks he can stand on his own.

examples.zh: 退休以后，妈妈给自己定了一个新目标：学书法。
examples.en: After retiring, Mom set herself a new goal: learning calligraphy.

examples.zh: 有了目标，退休生活一点儿也不无聊。
examples.en: With a goal in mind, retired life isn't boring at all.

examples.zh: 孩子上大学以后，妈妈把注意力转移到了自己身上。
examples.en: After her kid went to college, Mom shifted her attention to herself.

examples.zh: 他不想回答，就故意转移话题。
examples.en: He didn't want to answer, so he deliberately changed the subject.

examples.zh: 退休了，就应该好好享受生活。
examples.en: Once you're retired, you should really enjoy life.

examples.zh: 我很享受一个人在咖啡馆看书的时间。
examples.en: I really enjoy reading alone in a café.

examples.zh: 爷爷奶奶最大的愿望就是享受天伦之乐。
examples.en: Grandpa and Grandma's greatest wish is to enjoy the happiness of family life.

examples.zh: 春节全家团圆，老人们尽享天伦之乐。
examples.en: The whole family reunites at Spring Festival, and the old folks fully enjoy family happiness.

examples.zh: 我妈妈退休后在老年大学学书法。
examples.en: After retiring, my mom studies calligraphy at a senior college.

examples.zh: 中国书法很难，写好一个字都不容易。
examples.en: Chinese calligraphy is hard—even writing one character well isn't easy.

examples.zh: 妈妈常和几个老朋友结伴去旅行。
examples.en: Mom often travels together with a few old friends.

examples.zh: 晚上回宿舍最好和同学结伴，别一个人走。
examples.en: It's best to walk back to the dorm with a classmate at night—don't go alone.

examples.zh: 爸爸出差了，妈妈一个人在家很孤单。
examples.en: Dad's away on business, so Mom feels lonely at home by herself.

examples.zh: 刚来中国的时候，我常常感到孤单。
examples.en: When I first came to China, I often felt lonely.

examples.zh: 我以为他会生气，没想到他反而笑了。
examples.en: I thought he'd get angry, but instead he laughed.

examples.zh: 退休后妈妈不但没闲着，反而比以前更忙了。
examples.en: Since retiring, Mom hasn't been idle—on the contrary, she's busier than before.

examples.zh: 工作曾经占据了她全部的生活。
examples.en: Work once took up her whole life.

examples.zh: 这家公司占据了国内一半的市场。
examples.en: This company holds half of the domestic market.

examples.zh: 有了新目标，妈妈学习的动力更足了。
examples.en: With a new goal, Mom is even more motivated to learn.

examples.zh: 天天加班，我对工作已经失去了动力。
examples.en: Working overtime every day, I've lost my motivation for work.

examples.zh: 孩子离开家以后，她心里有一种失落感。
examples.en: After her child left home, she felt a sense of loss.

examples.zh: 没考上理想的大学，他很失落。
examples.en: He was very disappointed not to get into the university he wanted.

examples.zh: 退休后每天只看电视，生活太单调了。
examples.en: Just watching TV every day after retiring makes life too monotonous.

examples.zh: 这份工作很单调，每天都做同样的事。
examples.en: This job is dull—it's the same thing every day.

examples.zh: 帮助别人让她觉得生活很有意义。
examples.en: Helping others makes her feel her life is meaningful.

examples.zh: 这个词在不同的句子里意义不一样。
examples.en: This word has different meanings in different sentences.

examples.zh: 妈妈经常参加社区组织的活动。
examples.en: Mom often joins activities organized by the community.

examples.zh: 我们社区有一个免费的图书室。
examples.en: Our community has a free reading room.

examples.zh: 老人可以做一些力所能及的家务。
examples.en: Elderly people can do some housework within their abilities.

examples.zh: 朋友有困难，我总是给他们力所能及的帮助。
examples.en: When friends are in trouble, I always give them whatever help I can.

examples.zh: 遇到一点儿困难，他就很悲观。
examples.en: He gets pessimistic at the slightest difficulty.

examples.zh: 别那么悲观，事情总会好起来的。
examples.en: Don't be so pessimistic—things will get better.

examples.zh: 那段时间很难，但她终于熬过来了。
examples.en: That period was hard, but she finally got through it.

examples.zh: 为了准备考试，他昨天熬了一个通宵。
examples.en: He stayed up all night yesterday preparing for the exam.

examples.zh: 她觉得自己的汉语不好，有点儿自卑。
examples.en: She thinks her Chinese isn't good and feels a bit inferior.

examples.zh: 自信一点儿，你没有必要自卑。
examples.en: Be more confident—there's no need to feel inferior.

examples.zh: 她很敏感，别人一句话就能让她难过。
examples.en: She's very sensitive—a single remark can upset her.

examples.zh: 我的皮肤对阳光很敏感。
examples.en: My skin is very sensitive to sunlight.

examples.zh: 很多中国家长愿意在孩子的教育上投资。
examples.en: Many Chinese parents are willing to invest in their children's education.

examples.zh: 炒股是一种风险很大的投资。
examples.en: Trading stocks is a high-risk investment.

examples.zh: 退休后，妈妈的身体反而改善了不少。
examples.en: After retiring, Mom's health actually improved quite a bit.

examples.zh: 我们俩谈了一次，关系改善了很多。
examples.en: We had a talk, and our relationship improved a lot.

lessons.title: 实习不是打杂儿
lessons.titleEn: An Internship Isn't Just Running Errands

examples.zh: 我已经给三家公司投了简历。
examples.en: I've already sent my résumé to three companies.

examples.zh: 她把写好的文章投给了一家杂志。
examples.en: She submitted her finished article to a magazine.

examples.zh: 简历要写得简单明了。
examples.en: A résumé should be concise and clear.

examples.zh: 面试那天，记得多带几份简历。
examples.en: On the day of the interview, remember to bring a few extra copies of your résumé.

examples.zh: 我想申请市场部的实习职位。
examples.en: I want to apply for the internship position in the marketing department.

examples.zh: 这个职位要求会说中文和英文。
examples.en: This position requires both Chinese and English.

examples.zh: 我通过了第一轮面试，下周还有第二轮。
examples.en: I passed the first round of interviews, and there's a second round next week.

examples.zh: 这一轮比赛我们队输了。
examples.en: Our team lost this round of the competition.

examples.zh: 他被一家大公司录用了。
examples.en: He was hired by a big company.

examples.zh: 公司今年只录用了五个实习生。
examples.en: The company took on only five interns this year.

examples.zh: 实习可以把课堂上的知识应用到工作中。
examples.en: An internship lets you apply classroom knowledge at work.

examples.zh: 这种新技术已经应用到手机支付上了。
examples.en: This new technology has already been applied to mobile payment.

examples.zh: 光看书不够，还要多实践。
examples.en: Reading books alone isn't enough—you also need plenty of practice.

examples.zh: 在实践中学习，往往进步更快。
examples.en: Learning through practice often brings faster progress.

examples.zh: 师兄给了我很多找实习的建议。
examples.en: A senior fellow student gave me lots of advice on finding an internship.

examples.zh: 他是我的师兄，比我早两年进实验室。
examples.en: He's my senior—he joined the lab two years before me.

examples.zh: 这个市场里有很多廉价的商品，但质量一般。
examples.en: This market has lots of cheap goods, but the quality is mediocre.

examples.zh: 廉价的东西不一定划算。
examples.en: Cheap things aren't necessarily a good deal.

examples.zh: 有些公司把实习生当作廉价劳动力。
examples.en: Some companies treat interns as cheap labor.

examples.zh: 这个地区年轻人少，劳动力不足。
examples.en: There are few young people in this region, so there's a labor shortage.

examples.zh: 我实习的时候每天只是复印、打杂儿。
examples.en: During my internship all I did every day was photocopying and odd jobs.

examples.zh: 我不怕打杂儿，就怕什么也学不到。
examples.en: I don't mind doing odd jobs; I'm just afraid of learning nothing.

examples.zh: 实习也能拿学分，所以很多同学都去。
examples.en: You can earn credits for internships too, so many students do them.

examples.zh: 这学期我还差四个学分才能毕业。
examples.en: I'm still four credits short of graduating this semester.

words.meaning: put into practice what one has learned

examples.zh: 实习最大的好处是能学以致用。
examples.en: The biggest benefit of an internship is being able to put what you've learned into practice.

examples.zh: 他学了经济学，在公司里正好学以致用。
examples.en: He studied economics, and at the company he can put it to good use.

examples.zh: 他毕业后想去外资企业工作。
examples.en: After graduating he wants to work at a foreign-funded enterprise.

examples.zh: 这家企业每年都招很多实习生。
examples.en: This company recruits many interns every year.

examples.zh: 今天学校进行了消防演习。
examples.en: The school held a fire drill today.

examples.zh: 实习不是演习，你做的每件事都很重要。
examples.en: An internship isn't a drill—everything you do matters.

examples.zh: 这家非政府组织帮助贫困家庭。
examples.en: This NGO helps poor families.

examples.zh: 我暑假想去一家非政府组织实习。
examples.en: This summer I'd like to intern at an NGO.

examples.zh: 这两种方法大同小异，你可以任选一种。
examples.en: These two methods are much the same; you can pick either one.

examples.zh: 这几家公司的实习待遇大同小异。
examples.en: The internship conditions at these companies are pretty much alike.

examples.zh: 入职前要先办理各种手续。
examples.en: Before starting the job, you have to go through all kinds of procedures.

examples.zh: 我得去教务处办理成绩证明。
examples.en: I need to go to the academic affairs office to get my transcript.

examples.zh: 公司比较看重实习生的专业背景。
examples.en: The company puts quite a lot of weight on interns' academic backgrounds.

examples.zh: 我们来自不同的文化背景，想法自然不一样。
examples.en: We come from different cultural backgrounds, so naturally we think differently.

examples.zh: 公司会给实习生买保险吗？
examples.en: Does the company buy insurance for interns?

examples.zh: 出国旅行最好买一份旅游保险。
examples.en: When traveling abroad, it's best to buy travel insurance.

examples.zh: 这家公司每月给实习生两千元补贴。
examples.en: This company gives interns a 2,000-yuan allowance each month.

examples.zh: 政府给困难家庭提供生活补贴。
examples.en: The government provides living subsidies for needy families.

words.meaning: seek common ground while reserving differences

examples.zh: 和同事意见不同时，要学会求同存异。
examples.en: When you disagree with colleagues, learn to seek common ground while respecting differences.

examples.zh: 两国在贸易问题上决定求同存异。
examples.en: The two countries decided to seek common ground on trade while setting aside their differences.

examples.zh: 我做事有一个原则：答应别人的事一定做到。
examples.en: I have a principle: if I promise someone something, I do it.

examples.zh: 求同存异是合作的基本原则。
examples.en: Seeking common ground while respecting differences is a basic principle of cooperation.

examples.zh: 我在一家国际贸易公司实习。
examples.en: I'm interning at an international trading company.

examples.zh: 中国和很多国家都有贸易往来。
examples.en: China has trade relations with many countries.

lessons.title: 我的选择困难症又犯了

examples.zh: 超市里牙膏的种类太多了，我不知道选哪个。
examples.en: There are so many kinds of toothpaste at the supermarket that I don't know which to pick.

examples.zh: 这家店的茶有几十个种类。
examples.en: This shop has dozens of kinds of tea.

examples.zh: 我的选择困难症又犯了，不知道点什么菜。
examples.en: My indecisiveness is acting up again—I don't know what to order.

examples.zh: 他得了一种很少见的病症。
examples.en: He has a very rare medical condition.

examples.zh: 毕业生面临很多选择。
examples.en: Graduates are faced with lots of choices.

examples.zh: 这家公司正面临很大的困难。
examples.en: This company is facing major difficulties.

examples.zh: 他下决心今年一定要学好汉语。
examples.en: He's made up his mind to master Chinese this year.

examples.zh: 我想减肥，但总是下不了决心。
examples.en: I want to lose weight, but I can never bring myself to commit.

examples.zh: 这两款手机价格差异很大。
examples.en: The prices of these two phones differ a lot.

examples.zh: 南方和北方在饮食上有不少差异。
examples.en: There are quite a few differences in diet between the south and the north.

examples.zh: 无论你说什么，反正我不去。
examples.en: Whatever you say, I'm not going anyway.

examples.zh: 反正还有时间，我们慢慢讨论吧。
examples.en: We still have time anyway, so let's discuss it slowly.

examples.zh: 我再三考虑，还是决定买这件。
examples.en: After thinking it over again and again, I decided to buy this one.

examples.zh: 老师再三提醒我们别迟到。
examples.en: The teacher reminded us repeatedly not to be late.

examples.zh: 他性格优柔寡断，连点菜都要想半天。
examples.en: He's so indecisive that even ordering food takes him forever.

examples.zh: 做大事不能优柔寡断。
examples.en: You can't be indecisive when it comes to big things.

examples.zh: 买不买这台电脑，我还犹豫不决。
examples.en: I still can't decide whether to buy this computer.

examples.zh: 看他犹豫不决的样子，我就替他选了。
examples.en: Seeing how hesitant he was, I just chose for him.

examples.zh: 这件事你自己拿主意吧。
examples.en: You make up your own mind about this.

examples.zh: 我拿主意总是很慢，两件衣服挑了半天。
examples.en: I'm always slow to make up my mind—it took me ages to choose between two outfits.

examples.zh: 我的生活费有限，不能买太贵的东西。
examples.en: My living allowance is limited, so I can't buy anything too expensive.

examples.zh: 时间有限，我们说重点吧。
examples.en: Time is limited, so let's get to the point.

examples.zh: 我每个月去超市买一次日用品。
examples.en: I go to the supermarket once a month to buy daily necessities.

examples.zh: 牙膏、毛巾这些日用品，网上买更便宜。
examples.en: Daily necessities like toothpaste and towels are cheaper online.

examples.zh: 两个朋友同时请我吃饭，我左右为难。
examples.en: Two friends invited me to dinner at the same time, and I was caught in a dilemma.

examples.zh: 这个问题真让人左右为难。
examples.en: This problem really puts you in a bind.

examples.zh: 我不能容忍别人在我房间里抽烟。
examples.en: I can't tolerate people smoking in my room.

examples.zh: 他对孩子的坏习惯太容忍了。
examples.en: He's too tolerant of his child's bad habits.

examples.zh: 世界上没有完美的选择。
examples.en: There's no such thing as a perfect choice.

examples.zh: 她做什么都要求完美，所以很累。
examples.en: She demands perfection in everything, so she's always exhausted.

words.pinyin: jīn wú zúchì, rén wú wánrén
words.meaning: no one is perfect; everyone has flaws

examples.zh: 金无足赤，人无完人，我们要学会包容。
examples.en: No one is perfect, so we should learn to be tolerant.

examples.zh: 他也会犯错，毕竟金无足赤，人无完人。
examples.en: He makes mistakes too—after all, nobody's perfect.

words.meaning: suit the remedy to the case

examples.zh: 解决问题要对症下药。
examples.en: To solve a problem, you have to tackle its root cause.

examples.zh: 医生根据病情对症下药。
examples.en: The doctor prescribes treatment according to the patient's condition.

examples.zh: 有时候我会跟着感觉走。
examples.en: Sometimes I just follow my gut.

examples.zh: 选专业不能只跟着感觉走。
examples.en: You can't choose a major on gut feeling alone.

examples.zh: 选专业是人生中一个重大的决定。
examples.en: Choosing a major is a major decision in life.

examples.zh: 这次会议讨论了几个重大问题。
examples.en: This meeting discussed several important issues.

examples.zh: 做决定之前，先比较一下利弊。
examples.en: Before deciding, weigh the pros and cons first.

examples.zh: 留学的利弊，我们都分析过了。
examples.en: We've already analyzed the pros and cons of studying abroad.

examples.zh: 她很果断，几分钟就做了决定。
examples.en: She's very decisive—she made up her mind in a few minutes.

examples.zh: 发现方法不对，他果断放弃了。
examples.en: Realizing the method was wrong, he decisively gave it up.

examples.zh: 我想克服自己的选择困难症。
examples.en: I want to overcome my indecisiveness.

examples.zh: 刚来中国时，我克服了很多困难。
examples.en: When I first came to China, I overcame lots of difficulties.

examples.zh: 请你尽快决定，商店快关门了。
examples.en: Please decide quickly—the store is about to close.

examples.zh: 收到消息后请尽快回复我。
examples.en: Please reply as soon as you get the message.

examples.zh: 每次做选择对我来说都很痛苦。
examples.en: Making choices is always painful for me.

examples.zh: 那是一段痛苦的经历，我不想再提了。
examples.en: That was a painful experience; I don't want to bring it up again.

examples.zh: 选东西时可以适当降低要求。
examples.en: When choosing things, you can lower your standards a bit.

examples.zh: 学习累了，要适当休息一下。
examples.en: When you're tired from studying, take a reasonable break.

examples.zh: 我还不确定周末去不去。
examples.en: I'm not sure yet whether I'm going this weekend.

examples.zh: 我们先确定一个标准，再挑选。
examples.en: Let's first set a standard, then make our choice.

examples.zh: 我坚决反对这个计划。
examples.en: I firmly oppose this plan.

examples.zh: 他态度很坚决，谁劝都没用。
examples.en: His mind is made up—no one can talk him out of it.

lessons.title: 春节没以前热闹了
lessons.titleEn: Spring Festival Isn't as Lively as It Used to Be

examples.zh: 除夕晚上，全家人坐在一起吃饭。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve, the whole family sits down to eat together.

examples.zh: 今年除夕我是在中国朋友家过的。
examples.en: This year I spent New Year's Eve at a Chinese friend's home.

words.meaning: family reunion dinner on Chinese New Year's Eve

examples.zh: 妈妈从下午就开始准备年夜饭了。
examples.en: Mom started preparing the New Year's Eve dinner in the afternoon.

examples.zh: 现在很多人去饭店吃年夜饭。
examples.en: Nowadays many people have their New Year's Eve dinner at a restaurant.

examples.zh: 奶奶做的饭菜特别可口。
examples.en: Grandma's cooking is especially tasty.

examples.zh: 这家饭馆的菜又便宜又可口。
examples.en: The food at this restaurant is cheap and delicious.

examples.zh: 很多人觉得现在的春节没有年味了。
examples.en: Many people feel the Spring Festival has lost its festive flavor these days.

examples.zh: 街上挂满了红灯笼，年味越来越浓。
examples.en: The streets are hung with red lanterns, and the New Year feeling grows stronger.

examples.zh: 我的学费由父母负担。
examples.en: My parents cover my tuition.

examples.zh: 给很多亲戚压岁钱，对年轻人是一种负担。
examples.en: Giving lucky money to lots of relatives is a burden for young people.

examples.zh: 过年的时候，家里的气氛特别热闹。
examples.en: At New Year the atmosphere at home is especially lively.

examples.zh: 他一开玩笑，会议的气氛就轻松多了。
examples.en: As soon as he cracked a joke, the mood of the meeting relaxed a lot.

examples.zh: 春节期间，学校里很冷清。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival the campus is very quiet.

examples.zh: 只有两个人过年，感觉有点儿冷清。
examples.en: Spending New Year with just two people feels a bit lonely.

examples.zh: 今年春晚的小品你觉得好笑吗？
examples.en: Did you find this year's Spring Festival Gala skits funny?

examples.zh: 全家人一边吃年夜饭一边看春晚。
examples.en: The whole family watches the Spring Festival Gala while eating New Year's Eve dinner.

words.meaning: stay up on Chinese New Year's Eve

examples.zh: 除夕晚上，我们一家人守岁到十二点。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve our family stayed up until midnight.

examples.zh: 守岁是中国春节的传统习俗。
examples.en: Staying up on New Year's Eve is a traditional Spring Festival custom.

examples.zh: 过年时，晚辈要给长辈拜年。
examples.en: At New Year, younger family members pay New Year's visits to their elders.

examples.zh: 在长辈面前说话要有礼貌。
examples.en: You should speak politely in front of your elders.

words.meaning: lucky money given to children at New Year

examples.zh: 小时候我最期待的就是拿压岁钱。
examples.en: When I was little, what I looked forward to most was getting lucky money.

examples.zh: 奶奶给每个孙子都准备了压岁钱。
examples.en: Grandma prepared lucky money for each of her grandchildren.

examples.zh: 孩子们天天盼望着过春节。
examples.en: The kids can't wait for the Spring Festival.

examples.zh: 我盼望早日和家人团圆。
examples.en: I'm longing to be reunited with my family soon.

examples.zh: 我很期待第一次在中国过春节。
examples.en: I'm really looking forward to my first Spring Festival in China.

examples.zh: 大家都对新的一年充满期待。
examples.en: Everyone is full of hopes for the new year.

examples.zh: 一到过年，回家的愿望就特别强烈。
examples.en: When New Year comes, the desire to go home becomes especially strong.

examples.zh: 这次比赛，他表现出了强烈的求胜心。
examples.en: In this competition he showed a strong will to win.

examples.zh: 有了微信，我们可以随时聊天儿。
examples.en: With WeChat, we can chat at any time.

examples.zh: 有问题随时给我打电话。
examples.en: Call me anytime if you have questions.

examples.zh: 天天熬夜不利于健康。
examples.en: Staying up late every night is bad for your health.

examples.zh: 只用手机拜年，不利于亲人之间的交流。
examples.en: Sending New Year greetings only by phone doesn't help communication among relatives.

examples.zh: 在网上买年货很省事。
examples.en: Buying New Year goods online is very convenient.

examples.zh: 春节不想做饭？订外卖最省事。
examples.en: Don't feel like cooking at New Year? Ordering takeout is the easiest option.

examples.zh: 过年时大家喜欢去亲戚家串门。
examples.en: At New Year people like to drop in on their relatives.

examples.zh: 现在邻居之间很少串门了。
examples.en: Nowadays neighbors rarely drop in on each other.

examples.zh: 很久不联系，朋友之间的关系就疏远了。
examples.en: If friends don't keep in touch for a long time, they drift apart.

examples.zh: 他最近好像在故意疏远我。
examples.en: He seems to be deliberately keeping his distance from me lately.

examples.zh: 很多人觉得年味越来越淡了。
examples.en: Many people feel the New Year atmosphere is getting weaker and weaker.

examples.zh: 这杯茶太淡了，我想泡得浓一点儿。
examples.en: This tea is too weak—I'd like to brew it a bit stronger.

examples.zh: 现在过年的很多习俗都简化了。
examples.en: Many New Year customs have been simplified nowadays.

examples.zh: 学校简化了留学生的报名手续。
examples.en: The school simplified the registration procedures for international students.

examples.zh: 春运期间要特别注意交通安全，避免发生事故。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival travel rush, pay special attention to road safety to avoid accidents.

examples.zh: 昨天这条路上发生了一起交通事故。
examples.en: There was a traffic accident on this road yesterday.

examples.zh: 我的新年愿望是去中国各地旅行。
examples.en: My New Year's wish is to travel all over China.

examples.zh: 他终于实现了留学的愿望。
examples.en: He finally fulfilled his wish to study abroad.

examples.zh: 春节是家人团圆的日子。
examples.en: The Spring Festival is a time for family reunions.

examples.zh: 我已经两年没回家和父母团圆了。
examples.en: I haven't gone home to be with my parents for two years.

examples.zh: 以前出门只能坐火车，如今坐飞机是平常事。
examples.en: In the past you could only travel by train; nowadays flying is nothing special.

examples.zh: 如今越来越多人使用手机支付。
examples.en: Nowadays more and more people pay by phone.

examples.zh: 如今物质丰富了，过年反而没那么兴奋了。
examples.en: Now that material goods are plentiful, New Year isn't as exciting as it used to be.

examples.zh: 除了物质生活，精神生活也很重要。
examples.en: Besides material life, spiritual life matters too.

examples.zh: 他是家里的独生子女。
examples.en: He's an only child.

examples.zh: 独生子女过年往往觉得有点儿冷清。
examples.en: Only children often find New Year a bit quiet.

words.meaning: passenger transport during the Spring Festival

examples.zh: 春运的火车票特别难买。
examples.en: Train tickets during the Spring Festival travel rush are especially hard to get.

examples.zh: 春运期间，火车站到处都是人。
examples.en: During the Spring Festival rush, the train station is packed with people.

lessons.title: 孩子的零花钱怎么给？
lessons.titleEn: How Should Kids Get Pocket Money?

examples.zh: 明天学校开家长会。
examples.en: The school is holding a parent-teacher meeting tomorrow.

examples.zh: 很多家长不知道该给孩子多少零花钱。
examples.en: Many parents don't know how much pocket money to give their kids.

examples.zh: 我小时候每周有二十块零花钱。
examples.en: When I was little, I got twenty yuan of pocket money a week.

examples.zh: 他用自己的零花钱给妈妈买了礼物。
examples.en: He bought his mom a present with his own pocket money.

examples.zh: 爷爷奶奶总是惯孩子，要什么给什么。
examples.en: Grandparents always spoil the kids, giving them whatever they want.

examples.zh: 别把孩子惯坏了。
examples.en: Don't spoil the child.

examples.zh: 怎么给孩子零花钱，也是一门学问。
examples.en: How to give kids pocket money is an art in itself.

examples.zh: 王教授很有学问。
examples.en: Professor Wang is very learned.

examples.zh: 孩子考得好，妈妈奖励了他一本书。
examples.en: Her son did well on the exam, so Mom rewarded him with a book.

examples.zh: 这次比赛的第一名能得到一千元奖励。
examples.en: The winner of this competition gets a 1,000-yuan prize.

examples.zh: 他这学期在学校表现很好。
examples.en: He's behaved well at school this semester.

examples.zh: 她在面试中表现得很出色。
examples.en: She performed brilliantly in the interview.

examples.zh: 孩子总乱花钱，真让人伤脑筋。
examples.en: The kid keeps wasting money—it's a real headache.

examples.zh: 选什么礼物是个伤脑筋的问题。
examples.en: What gift to choose is a tricky question.

examples.zh: 我们每个月定期给孩子零花钱。
examples.en: We give our child pocket money regularly every month.

examples.zh: 老人应该定期去医院检查身体。
examples.en: Elderly people should get regular checkups at the hospital.

examples.zh: 零花钱的数目要根据孩子的年龄来定。
examples.en: The amount of pocket money should depend on the child's age.

examples.zh: 一万块钱对学生来说不是个小数目。
examples.en: Ten thousand yuan isn't a small sum for a student.

examples.zh: 开学前，妈妈给我买了一套新文具。
examples.en: Before school started, Mom bought me a new set of stationery.

examples.zh: 学校门口有一家文具店。
examples.en: There's a stationery shop at the school gate.

examples.zh: 他把零花钱都用来买零食了。
examples.en: He spent all his pocket money on snacks.

examples.zh: 吃饭前别吃零食。
examples.en: Don't eat snacks before meals.

examples.zh: 作为家长，应该教孩子怎么管钱。
examples.en: As parents, you should teach your kids how to manage money.

examples.zh: 他把压岁钱作为自己的零花钱。
examples.en: He treats his New Year money as his own pocket money.

examples.zh: 他花钱一点儿也控制不住。
examples.en: He can't control his spending at all.

examples.zh: 父母不应该控制孩子的一切。
examples.en: Parents shouldn't control every aspect of their children's lives.

examples.zh: 暑假我去打工挣零花钱。
examples.en: In the summer I work part-time to earn pocket money.

examples.zh: 他工作很辛苦，挣得却不多。
examples.en: He works very hard but doesn't earn much.

examples.zh: 零花钱怎么用，让孩子自主决定。
examples.en: Let kids decide for themselves how to use their pocket money.

examples.zh: 上大学以后，学生有了更多的自主权。
examples.en: In college, students have more autonomy.

examples.zh: 父母信任孩子，孩子才会更有责任感。
examples.en: Only when parents trust their kids will the kids become more responsible.

examples.zh: 他说过很多次谎，大家已经不信任他了。
examples.en: He's lied many times, so nobody trusts him anymore.

examples.zh: 这个办法可行吗？
examples.en: Is this method workable?

examples.zh: 你的计划很好，但是不太可行。
examples.en: Your plan is good, but not very practical.

examples.zh: 这个太贵，要不我们买那个吧。
examples.en: This one's too expensive—how about we buy that one instead?

examples.zh: 快点儿走吧，要不就赶不上车了。
examples.en: Let's hurry, or else we'll miss the bus.

examples.zh: 我赞成每周给孩子固定的零花钱。
examples.en: I'm in favor of giving children a fixed weekly allowance.

examples.zh: 对于这个方案，大家都举双手赞成。
examples.en: Everyone wholeheartedly supports this plan.

examples.zh: 在北京生活，每个月花费不少。
examples.en: Living in Beijing costs quite a lot each month.

examples.zh: 这次旅行的花费比我想的多。
examples.en: This trip cost more than I expected.

examples.zh: 他把剩余的零花钱存了起来。
examples.en: He saved the leftover pocket money.

examples.zh: 考试时间只剩余十分钟了。
examples.en: There are only ten minutes left in the exam.

examples.zh: 除非有特殊情况，否则不能多给零花钱。
examples.en: Unless there are special circumstances, no extra pocket money.

examples.zh: 今天对我来说是一个特殊的日子。
examples.en: Today is a special day for me.

words.meaning: as far as possible; do one's best

examples.zh: 我会尽量少花钱。
examples.en: I'll try to spend as little as possible.

examples.zh: 明天的会很重要，你尽量早点儿来。
examples.en: Tomorrow's meeting is important, so try to come early.

examples.zh: 妈妈让我准备一个账本，记零花钱怎么用。
examples.en: Mom asked me to keep an account book to record how I spend my pocket money.

examples.zh: 她在账本上记录每天的开销。
examples.en: She records her daily expenses in an account book.

examples.zh: 让孩子管零花钱，可以帮他们建立正确的金钱观。
examples.en: Letting kids manage their pocket money helps them build a healthy attitude toward money.

examples.zh: 两家公司建立了合作关系。
examples.en: The two companies established a partnership.

examples.zh: 我们已经制订了明年的学习计划。
examples.en: We've already drawn up our study plan for next year.

examples.zh: 家长可以和孩子一起制订花钱的规则。
examples.en: Parents can set spending rules together with their kids.

examples.zh: 这个孩子自制力很强，从不乱花钱。
examples.en: This child has strong self-control and never wastes money.

examples.zh: 自制力差的人很容易沉迷手机。
examples.en: People with poor self-control easily get hooked on their phones.

examples.zh: 我舅舅住在北京。
examples.en: My uncle lives in Beijing.

examples.zh: 舅舅是我妈妈的哥哥，对我特别好。
examples.en: My uncle is my mom's older brother, and he's especially good to me.

examples.zh: 舅妈做的菜很好吃。
examples.en: My aunt's cooking is delicious.

examples.zh: 我在舅舅家住的时候，舅妈很照顾我。
examples.en: When I stayed at my uncle's, my aunt took good care of me.

examples.zh: 一个人住虽然辛苦，但是很自在。
examples.en: Living alone is hard, but you feel free.

examples.zh: 在别人家里，我总觉得不太自在。
examples.en: I never feel quite at ease in other people's homes.

examples.zh: 我和父母在很多问题上有分歧。
examples.en: My parents and I disagree on a lot of things.

examples.zh: 双方的分歧越来越大。
examples.en: The differences between the two sides keep growing.

examples.zh: 爸妈总把我当小孩儿看待。
examples.en: My parents always treat me like a little kid.

examples.zh: 你怎么看待年轻人搬出去住？
examples.en: What's your view on young people moving out?

examples.zh: 我已经成年了，这件事我自己做主。
examples.en: I'm an adult now; I'll make this decision myself.

examples.zh: 家里的大事都是爷爷做主。
examples.en: Grandpa makes all the big decisions in the family.

examples.zh: 这件事让您费心了，谢谢！
examples.en: Thank you for all the trouble you've taken over this!

examples.zh: 让父母为我的工作费心，我很过意不去。
examples.en: I feel bad making my parents go to so much trouble over my job.

examples.zh: 我想依靠自己的能力生活。
examples.en: I want to live on my own abilities.

examples.zh: 他遇到困难，总是依靠家人帮忙。
examples.en: Whenever he runs into trouble, he relies on his family for help.

examples.zh: 搬出去住以后，每月的开销大多了。
examples.en: After moving out, my monthly expenses went up a lot.

examples.zh: 房租是我最大的一笔开销。
examples.en: Rent is my biggest expense.

examples.zh: 住在家里很省心，什么都不用管。
examples.en: Living at home is hassle-free—I don't have to take care of anything.

examples.zh: 这孩子从小就让父母很省心。
examples.en: This child has never given his parents much to worry about.

examples.zh: 父母过于担心孩子，反而不好。
examples.en: Parents worrying too much about their kids actually does harm.

examples.zh: 你不要过于依赖别人。
examples.en: Don't rely too much on others.

examples.zh: 搬出去住可以让我更独立。
examples.en: Moving out can make me more independent.

examples.zh: 她十八岁就开始独立生活了。
examples.en: She started living on her own at eighteen.

examples.zh: 年轻人应该早点儿学会自立。
examples.en: Young people should learn to stand on their own feet early.

examples.zh: 他工作以后，经济上已经能够自立了。
examples.en: Since he started working, he's been financially self-supporting.

examples.zh: 住在家里总觉得受到约束。
examples.en: Living at home, I always feel restricted.

examples.zh: 他喜欢自由，不愿意受规则约束。
examples.en: He loves freedom and doesn't like being bound by rules.

examples.zh: 这不见得是一件坏事。
examples.en: This isn't necessarily a bad thing.

examples.zh: 他现在不回答，不见得是不同意。
examples.en: His not answering now doesn't necessarily mean he disagrees.

examples.zh: 我宁可吃点儿苦，也不想啃老。
examples.en: I'd rather put up with some hardship than live off my parents.

examples.zh: 他已经30岁了，但还在啃老。
examples.en: He's already 30 but still lives off his parents.

examples.zh: 搬不搬出去，最好双方好好商量一下。
examples.en: Whether or not to move out, it's best for both sides to talk it over properly.

examples.zh: 这个办法对双方都有好处。
examples.en: This approach benefits both sides.

examples.zh: 她一个人住，房间却收拾得井井有条。
examples.en: She lives alone, yet keeps her room in perfect order.

examples.zh: 他工作起来总是井井有条。
examples.en: He always works in a very orderly way.

examples.zh: 在关键时刻，父母总是支持我。
examples.en: At critical moments, my parents always support me.

examples.zh: 妈妈时刻都在担心我的安全。
examples.en: Mom worries about my safety all the time.

examples.zh: 总的来说，这次旅行很顺利。
examples.en: All in all, the trip went smoothly.

examples.zh: 总的来说，我们都同意这个方案。
examples.en: Overall, we all agree with this plan.

examples.zh: 工作再忙，也要多陪伴父母。
examples.en: No matter how busy work gets, spend more time with your parents.

examples.zh: 有朋友的陪伴，我一点儿也不孤单。
examples.en: With my friends around, I'm not lonely at all.

examples.zh: 父母不应该过多干涉孩子的生活。
examples.en: Parents shouldn't interfere too much in their children's lives.

examples.zh: 这是我的私事，请你别干涉。
examples.en: This is my private business—please don't interfere.

examples.zh: 与其交房租，不如跟父母住。
examples.en: Rather than paying rent, I might as well live with my parents.

examples.zh: 与其一直担心，不如马上行动。
examples.en: Rather than worrying all the time, it's better to act right away.

examples.zh: 一个人住久了，有时候会感到孤独。
examples.en: After living alone for a long time, you sometimes feel lonely.

examples.zh: 老人最怕的就是孤独。
examples.en: What old people fear most is loneliness.

examples.zh: 搬出去以后，我的生活反而更有规律了。
examples.en: After moving out, my life actually became more regular.

examples.zh: 学语言也有自己的规律。
examples.en: Learning a language has its own patterns too.

lessons.title: 读万卷书，行万里路
lessons.titleEn: Read Ten Thousand Books, Travel Ten Thousand Miles

words.pinyin: měi féng jiājié bèi sī qīn
words.meaning: on every festive occasion one misses one's family all the more

examples.zh: 每逢佳节倍思亲，中秋节我特别想家。
examples.en: On festive days one misses family all the more—at Mid-Autumn I miss home terribly.

examples.zh: 一个人在国外过春节，我才明白什么叫“每逢佳节倍思亲”。
examples.en: Spending the Spring Festival alone abroad, I finally understood what "missing family more on festive days" means.

examples.zh: 我吃不惯辣的，胃不太舒服。
examples.en: I'm not used to spicy food, and my stomach doesn't feel great.

examples.zh: 他胃不好，不能喝冰水。
examples.en: He has a weak stomach and can't drink ice water.

words.meaning: work a part-time job; work for others

examples.zh: 暑假我在一家咖啡馆打工。
examples.en: This summer I worked part-time at a café.

examples.zh: 很多年轻人离开家乡去大城市打工。
examples.en: Many young people leave their hometowns to work in big cities.

examples.zh: 我和家人隔着一个太平洋。
examples.en: A whole Pacific Ocean separates me from my family.

examples.zh: 我们隔两天就视频聊一次。
examples.en: We video chat every couple of days.

examples.zh: 他是自费来中国留学的。
examples.en: He came to study in China at his own expense.

examples.zh: 这次旅行是公费还是自费？
examples.en: Is this trip paid for by the organization or out of your own pocket?

examples.zh: 我曾经在北京学过一年汉语。
examples.en: I once studied Chinese in Beijing for a year.

examples.zh: 他曾经是我最好的朋友。
examples.en: He used to be my best friend.

examples.zh: 我完全沉浸在节日的气氛中。
examples.en: I was completely immersed in the festive atmosphere.

examples.zh: 他沉浸在小说里，连饭都忘了吃。
examples.en: He was so absorbed in the novel that he forgot to eat.

examples.zh: 他在中国住了十年，成了一个中国通。
examples.en: He lived in China for ten years and became a real China hand.

examples.zh: 我的目标是做个中国通。
examples.en: My goal is to become a China expert.

examples.zh: 她在大学里读汉学专业。
examples.en: She majors in Sinology at university.

examples.zh: 这所大学的汉学研究很有名。
examples.en: This university is well known for its Sinology research.

examples.zh: 这位汉学家翻译了很多中国古典小说。
examples.en: This Sinologist has translated many classical Chinese novels.

examples.zh: 我希望将来能成为一名汉学家。
examples.en: I hope to become a Sinologist one day.

examples.zh: 他眼界很高，一般的工作看不上。
examples.en: He has high standards and looks down on ordinary jobs.

examples.zh: 这次旅行让我大开眼界。
examples.en: This trip really opened my eyes.

examples.zh: 留学可以开阔眼界。
examples.en: Studying abroad can broaden your horizons.

examples.zh: 站在山顶上，视野非常开阔。
examples.en: From the mountaintop, the view is wide open.

examples.zh: 一个人在国外生活，让他变得成熟了。
examples.en: Living abroad on his own made him more mature.

examples.zh: 这个想法还不太成熟，我再想想。
examples.en: This idea isn't fully formed yet—let me think it over.

examples.zh: 出国留学能扩大我们的视野。
examples.en: Studying abroad can widen our perspective.

examples.zh: 前面的大楼挡住了我的视野。
examples.en: The building in front blocks my view.

examples.zh: 旅行可以增长见识。
examples.en: Traveling broadens your knowledge of the world.

examples.zh: 这次去西藏，我见识了很多以前没见过的东西。
examples.en: On this trip to Tibet I saw many things I'd never seen before.

examples.zh: 上海是一个非常国际化的城市。
examples.en: Shanghai is a very international city.

examples.zh: 现在的大学越来越国际化了。
examples.en: Universities are becoming more and more international.

examples.zh: 公司需要会说多种语言的人才。
examples.en: The company needs talented people who speak several languages.

examples.zh: 这所大学培养了很多国际化人才。
examples.en: This university has trained many globally minded professionals.

words.pinyin: dú wàn juàn shū, xíng wàn lǐ lù
words.meaning: read ten thousand books and travel ten thousand miles

examples.zh: 老师常说，读万卷书，行万里路。
examples.en: Our teacher often says: read ten thousand books and travel ten thousand miles.

examples.zh: 我来中国留学，就是想读万卷书，行万里路。
examples.en: I came to study in China because I wanted to read widely and travel far.

examples.zh: 在中国的这两年，我成长了很多。
examples.en: In these two years in China, I've grown a lot.

examples.zh: 父母希望孩子健康成长。
examples.en: Parents hope their children grow up healthy.

examples.zh: 这份工作要求本科以上学历。
examples.en: This job requires at least a bachelor's degree.

examples.zh: 学历高不一定能力强。
examples.en: Higher qualifications don't necessarily mean greater ability.

examples.zh: 她打算明年来北京进修汉语。
examples.en: She plans to come to Beijing next year for advanced Chinese study.

examples.zh: 公司派他出国进修半年。
examples.en: The company sent him abroad for six months of further training.

examples.zh: 我参加了学校的留学生交换项目。
examples.en: I joined the university's student exchange program.

examples.zh: 这个项目下个月就要完成了。
examples.en: This project will be finished next month.

examples.zh: 他来中国就是为了学习武术。
examples.en: He came to China precisely to learn martial arts.

examples.zh: 少林寺的武术很有名。
examples.en: Shaolin Temple's martial arts are famous.

examples.zh: 我们班有好几个华裔留学生。
examples.en: There are several international students of Chinese descent in our class.

examples.zh: 她是美国华裔，但不太会说中文。
examples.en: She's a Chinese American but doesn't speak much Chinese.

examples.zh: 他的汉语说得那么好，我很惊讶。
examples.en: I was surprised that his Chinese was so good.

examples.zh: 让人惊讶的是，他只学了一年汉语。
examples.en: What's surprising is that he's only studied Chinese for a year.

examples.zh: 中国越来越开放了。
examples.en: China is becoming more and more open.

examples.zh: 我们应该用开放的态度看待不同的文化。
examples.en: We should view different cultures with an open mind.

examples.zh: 他是班里唯一的外国学生。
examples.en: He's the only foreign student in the class.

examples.zh: 这不是唯一的选择，你再想想。
examples.en: This isn't the only option—think it over.

examples.zh: 我最近在学中国成语。
examples.en: I've been learning Chinese idioms lately.

examples.zh: 他说话喜欢用成语，我常常听不懂。
examples.en: He loves using idioms when he talks, and I often can't follow.

examples.zh: 在中国要主动和中国人聊天儿，才能进步。
examples.en: In China you have to take the initiative to chat with locals if you want to improve.

examples.zh: 她很主动，第一天就跟所有同学打了招呼。
examples.en: She's very proactive—she greeted all her classmates on the very first day.
